Dutton Estate Walk at Hinton Ampner
r.description: Explore Ralph Duttons vision for an estate, garden & house that would blend harmoniously into the surrounding Hampshire countryside. Admire all seasons from bluebells in spring to the autumn colours & wildlife from hares to rare barbastelle bats.

r.name: King Alfred's Way
r.description: King Alfreds Way is 350km (220 miles) off road route designed to be ridden clockwise. It starts & ends in Winchester. It is suitable for gravel or cross-country bikes.

r.name: Stewkeley Walk at Hinton Ampner
r.description: Enjoy the Hinton Ampner countryside on this short walk towards Kilmeston village. Discover parkland, meadows, wildlife, an avenue of beech trees and Kilmeston's manor house and Norman church. Accessible parking & toilets available.

r.name: Battle of Cheriton, Hinton Ampner
r.description: The Battle of Cheriton was a turning point in the English Civil War & resulted in an important Parliamentary victory that shaped England's future. Starting at Hinton Ampner church, follow in the footsteps of the men who fought on both sides of the battle
